svg.aria-label: backends(): 10 → 800 users in a week with zero downtime, the backend of an LLM markets agent. infra(): mean time to first response cut by over 90%, a self-healing Kubernetes operator across 75+ services. agents(): up to +10 percentage points for open-source Qwen models on AndroidWorld / MobileWorld, trained on trajectories from my agent harness.
